evidence_boundary.statement: Records are indexed as testimony, literature, art, cultural history or research context unless independently testable claims meet a different evidential standard.

source_families.topics: Psychography · Brazilian Spiritism · publications · reception history

source_families.title: Eileen J. Garrett Collection · UMBC
source_families.topics: Mediumship · parapsychology · spiritualism · research history
source_families.text: UMBC documents more than 12,000 books, over 100 periodicals and unique artefacts assembled by the Parapsychology Foundation. Collection custody and Garrett's institutional role are documented without authenticating psychic claims.

source_families.title: Hamilton Family fonds · Manitoba
source_families.topics: Séance registers · trance scripts · automatic writing · experimental controls
source_families.text: The University of Manitoba finding aid preserves attendance registers, affidavits, automatic writings, trance scripts, photographs and experimental notes. The unusually rich controls are part of the historical record, not proof that reported phenomena were paranormal.

source_families.title: Margery Crandon · UMBC Garrett Collection
source_families.topics: Walter Stinson · séance mediumship · Houdini · dispute history
source_families.text: UMBC records both Crandon's claimed communication with her deceased brother and the contemporary controversy and scepticism. Competing interpretations remain attached to the same record.

source_families.title: Maurice Barbanell and Silver Birch · Waterloo
source_families.topics: Silver Birch · trance mediumship · publishing · reception history
source_families.text: This doctoral history documents Barbanell's career and decades of attributed Silver Birch teachings. It is contextual scholarship, not an independent validation or a substitute for primary session records.

source_families.title: Allan Kardec · BnF digital edition
source_families.topics: Spirit teachings · multiple mediums · doctrine · publication history
source_families.text: The Bibliothèque nationale de France identifies this 474-page edition as teachings attributed to higher spirits through multiple mediums, collected and arranged by Kardec. The catalogue and exact digitised edition establish publication provenance, not the identity of the alleged sources.

source_families.title: Madge Gill · William Morris Gallery
source_families.period: Visionary art and archival objects · exhibition record · 2019
source_families.topics: Myrninerest · visionary art · drawings · textiles · archival objects
source_families.text: The council-operated gallery records that Gill attributed many works to a spirit-guide she called Myrninerest. The museum record preserves the artist's attribution and material range without treating external authorship as established.
